_note: Coco and Charlie on the ground floor of the house (home_floor1), once Evelyn has left. Petting a pet counts as meeting it (talked_to, MissionTracker). Coco uses her idle sheet; Charlie has no art yet, so he is drawn as a placeholder until his sprite exists. The lines are placeholders until the real words are added. our_new_home is the talk (CS-003) that plays once the house has been looked around and both pets have been met.
